sql: SELECT o.id, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY o.created_at RANGE BETWEEN to_days(trunc('30'::double precision)::int) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent FROM (SELECT * FROM pg.public.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) o WHERE o.created_at > ('2026-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp - to_months(trunc('6'::double precision)::int))
